pretreatments.description: Solar photocatalytic deflocculation using TiO2 embedded chitosan thin film (TCTF) for 25 minutes under solar radiation to remove extracellular polymeric substances (EPS).
Enzyme secreting bacterial disintegration using Bacillus jerish 03 and Bacillus jerish 04 (1 g dry cell weight/L) incubated at 40 °C with constant mixing for 42 h at pH 6.5.
